ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム」より、“シャア専用ゲルググ”が、MGシリーズ99体目として登場！ 脚部フレアスカートの裾を別パーツ化、インナーフレームへ装着を介して着脱可能 シールドには新たにマウントアームを設け、背部に装着した状態から腕部へ装備した状態への移行アクションを再現 腰部スカートは前面、側面、背面で独立可動 頭部モノアイは、首振りに連動した視線移動を再現 専用ビーム・ライフル、ビーム・ナギナタ、専用シールドなどの装備品が付属 同スケールのシャア・アズナブル（立ち、着座の2タイプ）、ララァ・スンのフィギュアに加え、エレカーが付属
en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam", "Char's Gelgoog" appears as the 99th figure in the MG series! The hem of the flared leg skirt is made into a separate part, and can be attached and removed by attaching it to the inner frame.The Seal has a new mount arm, reproducing the transition action from being attached to the back to being equipped on the arm.The waist skirt can be moved independently on the front, sides, and back.The head mono-eye reproduces the movement of the line of sight in conjunction with the swing of the head.Equipments such as a special beam rifle, beam naginata, and a special Seal are included. In addition to figures of Char Aznable (standing and seated) and Lalah Sun of the same scale, an electric car is included.
